sinusoidal-functions-parts.alt: The graph of y = 3 sin(pi t / 4) + 5 for t from 0 to 10. The dashed midline y = 5 runs halfway between the maximum 8 and the minimum 2. A vertical arrow from the midline up to the maximum shows the amplitude, 3. A horizontal arrow from t = 0 to t = 8 shows one period, 8; the frequency is 1/8 of a cycle per unit of t.
